about: #86 at night: the walk to the scouts, away from the court of the hopscotch, with no invite; a short stone and the words of the elder; a long stone, and the point at the enemy and the posts; the sounds of the shot and of the landing; a tap on a star that stays at the gate; and a walk away with the stick: the raid waits, and the elder calls one time.
allow: is under the bottom of the screen

steps.until: (() => { const r = tre.activeVillage.state().entities.find((e) => e.id === 'raid')?.raid; return Boolean(r && !r.result && r.enemies.length >= 1); })()
(() => { const r = tre.activeVillage.state().entities.find((e) => e.id === 'raid')?.raid; return Boolean(r && r.enemies.some((e) => e.state === 'wait')); })()

steps.check: JSON.stringify([...new Set(tre.activeVillage.sounds().map((x) => x.name))]).includes('sling') && JSON.stringify([...new Set(tre.activeVillage.sounds().map((x) => x.name))]).includes('thud')

steps.until: (() => { const r = tre.activeVillage.state().entities.find((e) => e.id === 'raid')?.raid; return Boolean(r && r.enemies.some((e) => e.state !== 'gone' && e.state !== 'retreat')); })()

steps.print: (() => { const r = tre.activeVillage.state().entities.find((e) => e.id === 'raid')?.raid; const h = tre.activeVillage.state().entities.find((e) => e.id === 'hero').position; return r ? Math.round(Math.hypot(h.x - r.wall.x, h.z - r.wall.z)) : -1; })()
